messages:
maya: Evening handoff incoming — I go oncall at 18:00 PT. Quick checklist before I sign on:
- confirm VPN + bastion ssh works
- pagerduty access + escalation policy visible
- runbook link checked for the two alert types we saw this week

sam: I can do a quick run through now. pinging @lee for PD check.

lee: I verified PagerDuty access earlier. Can everyone confirm you see the 'inference-latency' and 'model-fallback' escalation policies? :white_check_mark:

olivia: I can confirm. Also rotated the svc-token for the metrics exporter — creds pushed to vault. maya, confirm your vault read perms for secret/ops/metrics?

maya: I have vault read to secret/ops/* but not write. I can read the metrics token secrets. Thanks for rotating.

ops-bot: Scheduled test alert will run in 5 minutes for channel eng-oncall. Reply with ":ok:" to acknowledge.

sam: Quick VPN/bastion check (run from laptop):
```
ssh -J ec2-user@bastion.internal ec2-user@gpu-node-3
curl -sS http://localhost:9100/metrics | head -n 5
```
If that fails, try `ssh -A` and regen keys.

maya: SSH to bastion worked, forwarded to gpu-node-3, metrics endpoint returns. :thumbsup:

lee: PD test — I see the test alert in my mobile app. Escalation path fired to oncall schedule, then to escalation policy 2. Good.

olivia: Minor FYI: during the maintenance window this morning the cache invalidation job was delayed — runbook note updated with steps to flush prefix cache: https://internal.runbooks/redwood/inference/cache-flush

maya: Thanks. Two action items for me before I start shift: 1) verify KMS decrypt for model keys (already requested sandbox decrypt), 2) trigger ops-bot test alert so I can practice ack/resolve flow. Will report back in ~3m.

ops-bot: Running test alert now — `opsbot trigger-test --policy inference-latency --note "maya handoff smoke"`

maya: Ack'd and resolved test alert. All good from my side. Handing over: be aware of a potential flake on gpu-node-3 under high-batch load (seen 503s last night). Runbook has mitigation steps (drain node -> redeploy with lower batch size).

sam: Noted. If you get a chance, drop the small snippet for the drain command here.

maya: drain snippet:
```
kubectl cordon gpu-node-3
kubectl drain gpu-node-3 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
# then scale deployment to remove half of in-flight batches
kubectl set env deployment/inference-runtime BATCH_SIZE=8
```

lee: Great — thanks for the thorough handoff. Good luck on shift, maya. I'm available if escalation hits.

maya: Thanks all — starting the oncall now. :coffee:
